programs.title: Beyblade X
programs.desc: Ekusu Kurosu of Team Persona, who had vanished from Komaba Sushi, heads toward a street battle arena where Kuromu Ryugu of Team Pendragon awaits. Declaring, 'I will surpass the True One!' Kuromu confronts Ekusu with his launcher ready. Ekusu, thrilled at the chance to battle Kuromu again, is equally fired up. Just as their intense match is about to begin-what action does Kuromu take!? Later, back at Komaba Sushi, Ekusu reflects on Kuromu's words and makes a request to Multi Nanairo. Meanwhile, as Kuromu continues his training alone, he receives an unexpected visitor.

programs.desc: Happy App has begun its sleep study of Mateo, Izzie, Zoey, and Cooper by subduing them with goggles.
